title: a merge leaves nothing on the duplicate
line: the 1940 household's daughter merged into its son, the harness's own merge of two children of one family: her card names him from then on and is matched again inside the merge, where the matcher does not put her persona to him, so it closes superseded; her membership of the family folds onto his with the file's claim on it and leaves no row behind, and the owner's accept of his own card writes nothing on her

steps.say: the 1940 page arrives through the inbox: a card for each of the four it names
the owner merges the daughter into the son, both children of the family the household is

merge.note: harness: two children of one family merged, as one child entered twice under the same parents would be

expect.why: the merge names the membership it folded with the statement it moved, and the card it re-pointed with the keys rewritten
the merge changes the son's evidence: his cards are matched again as part of it, the rule over his conflicts first
the merge's audit row lists both
her card names the person she was merged into, and the merge matches his cards again: her persona is no fit for him, so the card closes superseded
the son already holds the child's place in the family: her row is folded onto his, never left as his sibling
the file's claim on her membership moved with it

steps.say: the owner accepts the son's own card: nothing is written on the merged person

expect.why: nothing is written on the merged person
and no plan is made for her again
